主要内容: On January 5, 2012, Henry Schein, Inc. announced the acquisition of all of Oak Hill Capital Partners' remaining interest in Butler Schein Animal Health. This acquisition marks a significant step in Henry Schein's expansion within the animal health sector. The press release detailing the transaction was attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The event was reported on January 5, 2012, and the filing was signed by Michael S. Ettinger, Senior Vice President and General Counsel of Henry Schein, Inc.
